text.guards: Periods that do not end sentences (Dr., St., e.g., i.e., etc.), initials, and a decimal number. Naive sentence splitting fragments all of these.

segments.text:
Dr. A. M. Reyes arrived at St. Brendan's at 4.30 p.m. on a Tuesday, carrying no luggage. The porter, Mr. Ellis, had been told to expect someone from the U.S. — a researcher, i.e. not a patient.

The file listed three conditions (fever, tremor, insomnia, etc.) and one note: approx. 12.5 hours since onset. Vol. II of the register had gone missing years ago.
